summary: Enhance your skills with our Strategic Asset & Communication Excellence Training. Master effective strategies for impactful communication and asset management.
lede: Strategic asset management and communication training helps professionals responsible for organizational resources build practical controls and report asset status clearly. It covers asset classification and registers, lifecycle planning, utilization, maintenance, risk checks, and concise reporting of asset condition, cost, and risks. Asset, operations, procurement, finance, facilities, and project professionals practise creating an asset plan, an audit-ready evidence file, and a performance report for stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals across various sectors who need to manage assets and communicate effectively about them.
modules: Strategic Asset Thinking and Why It Matters
Asset Classification, Registers, and Control Basics
Budgeting and Planning for Asset Sustainability
Reporting and Dashboarding That Drives Decisions
Digital Tools and Systems for Asset Control
Capstone: Asset Governance and Communication Plan
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of organizational asset management processes. Familiarity with stakeholder communication is beneficial but not required.
